purpose: Define shared state precedence and demo coverage rules so component states do not collapse into ambiguous visual or behavioral cues.
requiredOrderRules: disabled has highest precedence when present
focus has higher precedence than hover
error has higher precedence than hover
default is the lowest fallback unless an explicit terminal fallback exists
terminal fallbacks end in closed or unknown when declared
requiredDemoRules: declared component states must be represented in state demos
state demos must not invent undeclared component states
